messages:
alex: Heads-up: seeing ~3x p95 latency on cluster r15 around 13:02 UTC. Spike correlates with a burst of long prompts + tool-calls.

maria: Any traces/links?

alex: https://observability.redwood.internal/traces/1968723456 — flamegraph shows GPU kernels switching mid-request. profiler dump below:

```
PID 7892 TRACE 0x1a2b: kernel_switches=17, last_kernel=int8_fast, ideal_kernel=fp16_matmul, memcpy_ms=45
KVCACHE: evictions=1200, hit_rate=0.42
BATCH: avg_size=2.3, mixed_seq_lengths=true
```

sam: This smells like the scheduler-affinity hashing used for kernel selection. We're hashing tenant+route -> scheduler bucket -> kernel fingerprint. If the fingerprint doesn't include seq_len, short+long sequences get grouped and an int8 path gets selected for a long prompt -> memcpy/quant-dequant thrash.

kevin: Captured a request sample:
```
request_id=rq_88
tenant=t-99
model=redwood-v1-7b-q4f16
prompt_len=450
tool_calls=3
selected_kernel=int8_fast
```

jessica: KV cache churn is brutal during these bursts. Eviction rate spikes -> cache misses -> recompute KV -> extra GPU memcpy. Also tool-calling loop keeps opening streaming chunks so socket backpressure builds -> worker threads pile up.

alex: Immediate mitigations:
- throttle noisy tenant t-99 to 20rps
- enable strict_kernel_fallback for canary nodes
- pin a node for deep profiling

maria: Throttled t-99 now :white_check_mark:. P95 dropped back toward baseline within ~2m.

infra-bot: deploy created: `canary/sched/1968723456` (env=staging). Auto-rollback=15m.

kevin: Perf counters (staging canary):
```
GPU memcpy_ms: 42
kernel_exec_ms: 320
kernel_switches: 18
kv_evictions: 1200
batch_size_avg: 2.3
```

sam: Proposed next steps (tracking):
- Add seq_len to kernel-fingerprint (short/medium/long buckets)
- Change batching heuristic: avoid batching >200 with <50 tokens
- KV cache: bump per-tenant LRU weight; avoid cross-tenant eviction
- Add alert: kernel_switches/request > 3

jessica: I'll draft the scheduler + batching PRs and add unit tests for fingerprint stability. Will also add metrics `kernel_select_reason`, `seq_len_bucket`, `kv_cache_hit` to request logs.

alex: Cool. Owners: PR=jessica, rollout=alex, infra=sam. Leave canary running for 30m then expand if green.

maria: Also create a short playbook entry in incidents on this pattern (hashing mismatch + toolloop) so oncall can recognize.

alex: Agreed. Filed: https://issues.redwood/INC-4102

jessica: ack, starting work.

sam: thumbs up :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks all. Closing the thread when canary completes.
